cover owner algorithms; P32-S07--P32-S12 cover homology covers and lifts;
P32-S13--P32-S22 cover products, counting, and tails; and P32-S23--P32-S26

\citep{P32-S01,P32-S02,P32-S03,P32-S04,P32-S05,P32-S06,P32-S07,P32-S08,P32-S09,P32-S10,P32-S11,P32-S12,P32-S13,P32-S14,P32-S15,P32-S16,P32-S17,P32-S18,P32-S19,P32-S20,P32-S21,P32-S22,P32-S23,P32-S24,P32-S25,P32-S26}.
None is used as evidence that the combined dependency order is globally novel,
and every passage transfer remains \texttt{INCONCLUSIVE}. The bounded
design contribution is the explicit order local-factor derivation, conditional
scalar gate, formal-object construction, and compact-uniform tail obligation.
No priority or exhaustive originality claim is made.

The executed scholarly method was a closed-corpus synthesis: records were
captured, deduplicated, screened, and grouped under the frozen inclusion frame;
source-effect rows separated admitted contributions from excluded stronger uses
and applicability warnings; and unresolved source and theorem boundaries were
propagated into the research design. Four procedurally separated,
single-model-family roles then reviewed the report. Their
\texttt{MAJOR\_REVISION} outcome and the author's adjudication are development
provenance, not evidence for a factor, coefficient comparison, obstruction, or
limit. Revision 1 changes only the prospective dependency contract and its
stated evidence boundary.

\texttt{CP-P32-004} remains \texttt{flagged\_unresolved}. The coefficient
rings, exponent monoids, support conditions, transition maps, topologies,
localization domains, equality relations, and singleton projections for
\texttt{R\_+} have status \texttt{UNDEFINED}; the corresponding fields for
the separate zero-content Hahn-type object have the same status. Consequently
coefficient and singleton-projection comparisons are
\texttt{NOT\_EVALUABLE}. No formal object or operation is imported by analogy,
and no coefficient mismatch is used as a completed scientific finding.

Write \texttt{L(m,N;s)} only as a registry name for the prospective
ordered sum of the first \texttt{m} exact logarithmic owner summands; it is not
yet instantiated because the factors are unproved. For each compact
\texttt{K(delta,T,R)} and each schedule \texttt{S\_k} in
\texttt{\{N\_k=k!, N'\_k=2(k!)\}}, the wholly \texttt{UNPROVED} registry
contains: \texttt{AN-1}, owner exhaustion \texttt{m->infinity} at fixed
\texttt{S\_k}; \texttt{AN-2}, schedule growth \texttt{k->infinity} at fixed
\texttt{m}; \texttt{AN-3}, the iterated order
\texttt{k->infinity after m->infinity}; \texttt{AN-4}, the reverse iterated
order; and \texttt{AN-5}, the diagonal
\texttt{L(m\_k,S\_k;s)} with
\(m_k=2^k\). Every row requires the exact summand definition, an absolute
summable majorant uniform on the compact and independent of the permitted
indices, the coupling rule, and a named interchange statement. The prefix
\texttt{1<=k<=8} and panel sizes \texttt{m in \{8,16,32,64,128\}} remain
unexecuted diagnostics with no convergence force.

The executed method is a staged synthesis over frozen literature and
project records. Phase 2 captured 51 records, removed 12 duplicate
manifestations, screened 39 unique records, excluded 13, and retained 26
sources. At that historical Phase-2 checkpoint the identity layer classified
25 sources as \texttt{VERIFIED} and P32-S13 as \texttt{PLAUSIBLE}. A separately
authorized Stage-2.5 metadata repair subsequently verified P32-S13's
bibliographic identity, so the current identity state is 26 of 26
\texttt{VERIFIED}. The transition does not upgrade its background-only fitness,
\texttt{anchor:none} status, or \texttt{INCONCLUSIVE} claim-to-passage support.
The P32-S02 page correction, P32-S06 preprint boundary, and P32-S17
correction-limited support surface remain unchanged.

All 26 prose citations retain \texttt{anchor:none}. The frozen workflow
records aggregate capture and screening counts and the retained-source effects,
but it does not contain a complete 51-record inclusion/exclusion decision log
or exact theorem-page, hypothesis, and quotation locators for every transfer.
Claim-to-passage faithfulness therefore remains \texttt{INCONCLUSIVE}. No
retrieval or source-finalization was authorized for this revision, so missing
queries, decisions, and passages are reported as unavailable rather than
reconstructed after the fact.

The positive-content derivation contract now exposes its intermediate
targets. For homology content \texttt{d>0} and
\texttt{q\_N(g)=gcd(N,d)}, the proposed identities are deck-image order
\texttt{N/q\_N(g)}, lifted-component count
\(N^3 q_N(g)\), scaled period \texttt{ell(g)/q\_N(g)}, and logarithmically
normalized exponent \texttt{q\_N(g)}. Chaining only those proposed fields
gives the displayed \texttt{F\_N,g}; every identity has status
\texttt{UNPROVED}. A future ledger must bind the homology vector, content, deck
action, component count, covering degree, primitive-lift proof, unscaled and
scaled periods, raw exponent, both frozen normalizations, and resulting factor.
The zero-content ledger remains separate, and a read-only verifier must reject
any unresolved field.

No row records a constructed object, completed operation, or scientific
result.

The change is methodological. It does not assert that the candidate factors
are correct or that an obstruction exists. Higher- and zero-content checks are
earlier in the declared dependency graph because they require fewer named
downstream objects than formal topology and compact-uniform tails. This is not
an empirical runtime, proof-complexity, or information-gain estimate. A closed
adverse result would settle the universal endpoint negatively under the fixed
scheme; survival would license only the next predeclared obligation. A positive
content-one statement, if eventually proved, would remain restricted.

A minimal conditional scalar-check contract is now explicit but unexecuted.
Only after an independent derivation of the displayed factor may a future
checker fix \(\ell>0\), real \(s>0\), and integer \(m\geq 2\), then compare
\(\Phi_m(s)=(1-\exp(-s\ell/m))^{-m}\) with
\(B(s)=(1-\exp(-s\ell))^{-1}\) under ordinary equality of positive
real-valued functions. The proposed substitutions are \(m=d\) after
higher-content stabilization and \(m=N\) for zero content. The comparison
has status \texttt{UNPROVED/NOT\_EVALUABLE} because neither candidate factor
has been independently derived under the frozen \(1/N\) time and
\(1/N^3\) logarithmic normalizations. No inequality, factor mismatch,
obstruction, recovery result, or Route credit is asserted here.
